title: Smells even after washing. Hard pass.
text:
Smells even after washing. Hard pass.. I am not sure what to think about these pillowcases. The fabric feels nice, but for some reason, they smell to high heaven! They smell like you slathered yourself in mentholatum, then laid on the pillowcases all night.

I also thought these were all white, but they have a black stripe on one end that I don't care for. We are on the second washing of these pillowcases, trying to get that menthol smell out of them. I am not sure why they smell so bad, but I can't recommend these.

product_metadata.title: La Peluche Set of 2 Pillow Cases 800 Thread Count Soft & Cozy Luxury Cotton Collection (King, White)
